audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Vladimir Levels 1 through 4-5 and marked Level 6 as Skill; the packet chart is Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Kassadin/Vladimir/Vladimir.
audit.why: 50.9% over 668 games is an even lane, and the page's own prose already says levels 1-5 are even and that 6 favours Kassadin — the chart rows were the only part disagreeing.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 flipped to Skill and row 4 to Kassadin, proposed as matched full/content pairs in one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 row described Hemoplague generically and never gave Riftwalk's cooldown; no numbers anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s — it is not a cooldown you wait out mid-fight; Hemoplague is a flat 120s.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and spikes[1].text now carry both numbers; cooldown block rebuilt with Force Pulse 21s and Nether Blade 7s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Null Sphere a silence in four places ('Q-silence', 'his Q-silence combo'). Riot's text says it damages and interrupts channels, and shields magic damage — no silence. Kassadin's passive Void Stone (reduced magic damage) was never mentioned at all, on a matchup where every point of Vladimir's damage is magic.
audit.why: Void Stone is the decisive interaction here and it was absent; Force Pulse charges off spells cast in his vicinity, so Vladimir's own Q and E poke arm the ability that slows him; Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units while Kassadin's passive ignores unit collision.
audit.corrected: Silence claim removed and replaced with the real effects; Void Stone, the minion-block on Tides of Blood, and the self-charging Force Pulse all written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention that his burst opens on an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Nether Blade is a 7s auto reset — the wind-up, not a cast animation, is the tell to step back.

edits.before: Bully him early — drain him down and pool the Riftwalk answer. Vladimir wins the Riftwalk cooldown windows.
edits.after: Bully him pre-6 — but Void Stone cuts your magic damage, so lean on autos and the wave, not poke alone.

edits.before: Hemoplague + empowered Q turns mid-game fights into resets. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kassadin's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1 and drops to 2s — he blinks in, out, and back. Hemoplague is 120s, so spend it only when he has committed.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kassadin Riftwalk: 5s at rank 1, 2s at rank 3 — you never outrun it, you outlast it. - Force Pulse: 21s, and your own casts charge it. - Nether Blade: 7s auto reset. - Hemoplague: 120s, kill windows only.

edits.before: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1 — he will always get out, so trade for health, not for the kill.

edits.before: Transfusion Kassadin on cooldown, E-charge behind the wave, and pool the one ability his kill plan needs.
edits.after: Transfusion him on Nether Blade's 7s downtime — the auto wind-up is the tell, and your casts charge Force Pulse.

edits.after: Level 2 stays skill-based — Null Sphere shields magic, but he cannot all-in without his ult.

edits.before: Pre-6 Kassadin is weak — his Q shields your magic damage but he can't fight, so shove and chunk him with Transfusion and Tides of Blood while his waveclear is bad.
edits.after: Pre-6 Kassadin is weak, but Void Stone cuts all magic damage he takes and Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units — step off the wave so your E lands on him.

edits.before: Kassadin's Riftwalk (R) is his whole game — at 6 he can blink onto you, Q-silence and E-slow for a burst combo, and stacking Riftwalks snowball fast if you let him roam.
edits.after: Riftwalk (R) is his whole game — 5s at rank 1, 2s at rank 3. Null Sphere does not silence; it shields magic and interrupts channels, and Force Pulse slows in a 400 cone.

edits.after: Pool his Riftwalk-in burst — 2s untargetable eats it

notes: Null Sphere was described as a silence in four separate strings; Riot's text gives it damage, a channel interrupt and a magic shield only. I corrected the two highest-traffic instances (spikes[1], whys[1], wants.you[1]) — breakdown.trading and dontsFull still read cleanly without the word, so nothing else needed touching. Void Stone (passive magic damage reduction) was completely absent from a matchup where 100% of Vladimir's damage is magic; that is the single biggest gap on this page. Whether Void Stone's reduction is flat or percentage is not in Riot's text, so I wrote 'cuts' rather than a number.
